definition: right away and right where you are
description: A sunny cobbled street with striped café awnings and white bunting overhead. A young woman in a blue blazer, white blouse and black trousers, holding a brown handbag, stops in the middle of the street and dances right there, spinning and stepping, laughing. Beside her two young street dancers in bright shell suits with a portable speaker on the ground cheer her on, and behind her a young woman in a lilac suit and other people watch and clap, some with raised hands.
